appeal.unavailable.already_appealed.message: This action has already been appealed. Each action can be appealed only once.

appeal.unavailable.request_pending.message: This action has a request to lift that is still pending. You can appeal after it is reviewed.

appeal.unavailable.revoked.message: This action has been revoked, so there is nothing to appeal.

appeal.unavailable.window_ended.message: The appeal period for this termination has ended.

inquiry.seller_reply.body_length.message: Your reply must be 1 to 4000 characters.

inquiry.seller_reply.unavailable.replied.message: This inquiry has already been replied to and cannot be replied to again.

inquiry.seller_reply.unavailable.withdra.message: This inquiry has been withdrawn, so no reply is needed.

kyc.edit_unavailable.approved.message: Your seller verification is approved, so you do not need to edit or resubmit it.

kyc.edit_unavailable.under_review.message: Your application is under review. Cancel it first if you want to make changes.

measure.retry_exhausted.message: This action just changed. Please try again.

onboarding.payment_account.action_requir.message: Provide your identity and bank details to start getting paid. The payment provider collects this information; Hawkr does not handle it.

onboarding.payment_account.create_failed.message: We could not create your payout account. Please contact support.

onboarding.payment_account.disabled.message: The payment provider cannot activate your payout account right now. Please contact support.

onboarding.payment_account.locked.message: You can set up your payout account after the platform review is approved.

onboarding.payment_account.not_available.message: Payout setup is not open yet. You can continue once it opens.

onboarding.payment_account.preparing.message: We are creating your payout account. This usually takes a few minutes.

onboarding.payment_account.syncing.message: Your payout account status is being updated. Please check back later.

onboarding.payment_account.under_review.message: The payment provider is reviewing your account. You do not need to do anything.

onboarding.payment_account.unknown.message: We cannot read your payout account status right now. Please try again later.

onboarding.platform_review.cancelled.message: Your seller verification was cancelled. You can submit it again.

onboarding.platform_review.draft.message: Your seller verification is still a draft and has not been submitted.

onboarding.platform_review.not_submitted.message: You have not submitted a seller verification yet.

onboarding.platform_review.rejected.message: Your seller verification needs changes. Update it and submit again.

onboarding.platform_review.submitted.message: Your seller verification is under review. You do not need to do anything.

onboarding.platform_review.unknown.message: We cannot read your seller verification status right now. Please try again later.

onboarding.profile.completed.message: Your store name, logo and location are all set.

opening.unavailable.store_exists.message: You are already a seller, so you do not need to apply again.

opening.unavailable.suspended.message: Your account is suspended. You cannot open a store until the suspension is lifted.

remediation.unavailable.not_active.message: This action is not currently in effect.

remediation.unavailable.not_risk.message: Only actions based on a risk type can be requested to be lifted.

remediation.unavailable.remediation_pend.message: The request to lift this action is under review. You cannot submit another until the review is complete.

report.submit_conflict.message: A conflict occurred while submitting. Please try again shortly.
